name: Puno and Lake Titicaca
tagline: Floating reed islands on the world's highest navigable lake
summary: Puno sits on the shore of Lake Titicaca at 3,800 m, the starting point for island visits. Boat out to the Uros reed islands, stay with a family on Amantaní, see the textile traditions of Taquile, explore the burial towers of Sillustani and cross into Bolivia for Copacabana and the Isla del Sol.
seasonNote: Dry season (May to October) is sunny but nights are freezing; February has the Candelaria festival.
arrival: Juliaca airport is 45 minutes away; buses and the PeruRail Titicaca train come from Cusco.
gettingAround: Boats for islands; taxis and tours on land.
cashTip: Carry soles for markets, boats and tips; cards work in hotels and bigger restaurants.
foodTip: Lake trout, quinoa soup and alpaca.
